tool.name: gramm
tool.description: Global RAnge Molecular Matching for protein-protein docking

param.name: receptor_path
param.label: Receptor PDB
param.description: Optional receptor PDB. If omitted, docking uses the previous refinement output automatically.

param.name: ligand_path
param.label: Ligand PDB
param.description: Optional ligand PDB. If omitted, docking uses the previous refinement output automatically.

param.name: receptor_fragment
param.label: Receptor fragment
param.description: Fragment selector for receptor: *, chain id or atom range

param.name: ligand_fragment
param.label: Ligand fragment
param.description: Fragment selector for ligand: *, chain id or atom range

param.name: receptor_id
param.label: Receptor ID
param.description: Identifier used to name GRAMM output files

param.name: ligand_id
param.label: Ligand ID
param.description: Identifier used to name GRAMM output files

param.name: maxm
param.description: Number of scan matches to output

param.name: mtch_l
param.description: Number of scan matches to input into refine

param.name: maxmch
param.description: Maximum number of refinement matches to output

param.name: constraints
param.description: Optional raw rcon.gr content or serialized constraints payload

artifact.name: scan_predictions
artifact.label: Scan predictions
artifact.description: Docking scores and transformations for predicted poses

artifact.name: refined_complexes
artifact.label: Refined complexes
artifact.description: Final protein-protein docked complexes in PDB format
